name: MySQL
tagline: The web's default open-source SQL database, now on calendar versioning with 9.7 as the LTS line.
description: MySQL is the relational database that powered the LAMP era and still sits behind a huge share of web applications, CMSs and SaaS backends. Its InnoDB engine gives solid ACID OLTP with simple primary-replica and Group Replication topologies, and the operational knowledge around it (Vitess, ProxySQL, Orchestrator, gh-ost) is unmatched. Oracle owns it and develops it in-house, which keeps the GPL community edition alive but steers advanced features toward Enterprise Edition and HeatWave. In 2026 Oracle moved Innovation releases to calendar versioning (26.7, 26.10), while 8.4 and 9.7 are the LTS lines most teams should run.

pricing.notes: Community Edition is free under GPLv2; Enterprise Edition (thread pool, audit, TDE, backup) is sold per server by Oracle.

scale.notes: Single-primary by default; comfortable into multi-TB on one primary. Group Replication/InnoDB Cluster for HA; Vitess or NDB for sharded write scale-out to much larger sizes.

strengths: Huge operational ecosystem: Vitess, ProxySQL, Orchestrator, gh-ost, pt-online-schema-change
Binlog-based replication and CDC that every ETL and streaming tool understands
Simple to run, with predictable InnoDB performance on read-heavy OLTP
Managed by every cloud provider and by MySQL-compatible distributed systems (TiDB, PlanetScale)
InnoDB tablespace encryption and instant ADD COLUMN in the community edition
weaknesses: Single-vendor control by Oracle; roadmap and commit history are not developed in the open
Weaker SQL feature set than PostgreSQL (no partial indexes, limited CHECK/domain types, no transactional DDL)
Thread pool, audit log and hot backup are Enterprise-only
Horizontal write scaling requires Vitess, NDB or a third-party distributed engine
useCases: Web applications and CMS backends (WordPress, Drupal, Magento)
Source database for binlog-driven CDC pipelines
notIdealFor: Complex analytical queries over large tables
Workloads needing rich extensibility like custom types or index methods
Multi-region active-active writes without extra tooling
